changelog:
WhatsApp hand-off: Appearance > Contatti has an optional WhatsApp number (with the country code, saved as digits; a wrong length is refused and the previous number stays). The widget shows "Oppure contattaci direttamente: WhatsApp · phone · email" under the contact form and in error messages; the WhatsApp link opens wa.me in a new tab with no prefilled text, so the chat conversation is not sent.
FAQ drafts from unanswered questions: next to each unanswered question and each answer marked not helpful, "Crea bozza di FAQ" creates a manual source with the masked question and "Risposta: [DA COMPLETARE]", excluded until completed, and opens it for editing. A source that still contains [DA COMPLETARE] can be neither included nor approved, so an empty answer never reaches visitors.
Answer ratings: visitors can mark each verified chat answer as helpful or not helpful (thumbs up/down; the last vote counts). The site keeps only the vote, the cited sources and an anonymous conversation code, for 13 months, in a new table removed on uninstall. The Overview shows the ratings of the last 30 days; the unanswered questions page lists the answers marked not helpful in the last day, with the question masked, and the sources most often cited by unhelpful answers.
Lead CSV export: Richieste has an "Esporta CSV" button that downloads all leads, or only the undelivered ones, as a semicolon-separated UTF-8 file for Excel. It includes contact details, delivery status, consent and the visitor's last question, not the whole conversation; cells that would start a formula are neutralised.
Cheap default model: under each provider's model field, Settings > Provider AI recommends the cheapest model (gpt-4.1-mini, claude-haiku-4-5) with a button to use it, shows the estimated cost of the chosen model (euro per million tokens and about how much 100 typical questions cost) and warns when the model has no price in the list. The field suggests the priced models of that provider. New installations start from the cheap models; a model already chosen is never changed.
Initial check in one click, in the Overview and in the last step of the guided setup. It tests the AI key and model (skipped when the monthly spending cap is reached), sends a test email to the lead recipient, and checks WP-Cron (cleanup scheduled and on time, DISABLE_WP_CRON, the site able to call its own wp-cron.php), HTTPS (site addresses and a certificate the site accepts) and the privacy policy link. Each result says what to do and links to the page where it is fixed. The last result stays in the Overview and is removed on uninstall. A missing AI model (HTTP 404) now has its own message.
Cost control: every accepted AI call records its tokens, without any content. The Overview shows the estimated cost of the month in euro, split between chat and panel, with the average and highest cost per conversation. Settings > Limiti has an editable price list (US dollars per million tokens, with gpt-4.1-mini and claude-haiku-4-5 prices), a dollar-to-euro rate and a monthly spending cap (20 euro by default, 0 for none). At the cap the chat offers the contact form without calling the provider until the next month; the panel keeps working and warns on every page, from 80% of the cap. Usage data is kept 13 months and removed on uninstall.
The chat speaks for the business in the first person plural: "Hai domande? Chiedi a noi", a new default welcome, plural fixed replies and error messages, the same texts in the Appearance preview, and a prompt rule asking the AI model for the plural.
Fixed: the widget shipped in the plugin now matches the widget source again.
External services section rewritten for the WordPress.org directory: for OpenAI and Anthropic, what is sent and when (connection test, source analysis, PDF reading, visitor chat), what is never sent, and links to each provider's terms and privacy policy.
WordPress.org package: a second build without the aiframe.it update checker, checked by Plugin Check with no exclusions. The private beta package and its updates from aiframe.it are unchanged.
